title: stramonium metel
intro: Stramonium metel, commonly known as Thorn Apple, is a poisonous flowering plant in the nightshade family that is native to Europe and Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and ease pain. The therapeutic actions of Stramonium metel include its antispasmodic, sedative, and anxiolytic effects, making it useful for treating conditions such as insomnia and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Stramonium metel include alkaloids like scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
